title: Hive-mind
description: One real mind per hive, worker ants as subminds. Deliberately minimal schema shape.

hive_state.description: The hive's actual operational state -- primary content for this mind-shape, not a secondary embodiment layer.

resources.description: References into the SHARED world-state file's finite resource entries -- not a private copy.

worker_dispatch_state.description: What worker-ant subminds are currently dispatched to do. Workers never carry their own separate identity/schema document -- they are represented here, as dispatch state of the ONE hive-mind.

stockpile.description: Optional. The hive's OWN accumulated resources, credited from successful gathers, distinct from `resources` (which only references the shared pool). Decays each tick via upkeep -- this is what makes survival/resource-based reward (operator, 2026-07-16) a real consequence rather than a narrated one.

knock_equivalent.description: Floor field. Resolved (operator, 2026-07-16): survives the welfare-gate exemption.

reachable.description: Fixed true. Never optional or defaulted-off.

dignity_floor_equivalent.description: Floor field. Resolved (operator, 2026-07-16): survives the welfare-gate exemption.
